title: Acute Effects of Different Macronutrient Compositions and Meal Distributions of the Food
brief_summary: About thirty participants, of varying degrees of obesity or being non-obese, without serious concomitant diseases consume either a high- or a low- carbohydrate beverage. The beverage is also consumed either as one single drink or as 5 small portions in the morning and are tested for effects on major cardiovascular risk markers and on metabolic rate for three hours on each occasion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy participants \> 18 years with or without obesity

Exclusion Criteria:

* Major illnesses,
* thyroid diseases,
* need to take prednisolone,
* psychiatric disease,
* inability to understand Swedish
